name: inbox_import
description: Use a file the user ALREADY HAS in this computer's Downloads folder inside the Sandbox. Give the file name only (e.g. "tailscale-setup-1.102.4.exe"), never a path: only files directly in Downloads can be taken. The file is copied (the original stays) into the shared inbox, which the Sandbox sees read-only; a few seconds later it is in the Sandbox desktop folder Input, checked against its SHA-256 (Desktop\input-check.html shows OK or FAIL). Nothing is opened or run on this computer. When the user names a file or program without giving a URL, use this tool (list the Downloads folder first if unsure of the exact name) instead of searching the web or downloading another package. At most 50 MiB.

name.description: File name in the Downloads folder, without any folder part.

annotations.title: Copy a downloaded file into the Sandbox inbox
